description: This file defines a Java class SendEmailTask that extends AbstractTask and implements a scheduled task for sending emails within the OpenMRS platform. The class primarily manages session handling and logs the execution and shutdown events.

classes.name: SendEmailTask
classes.description: A task class responsible for sending emails, which manages database sessions and logs its activity.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles the execution of the email-sending task, managing session lifecycle and logging activity.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup or shutdown procedures for the task, primarily logging shutdown activity.
